text:
maria: quick heads-up: we rolled py & ts SDKs in tonight's 23:00 UTC window. seeing a few downstream errors reported, tagging the thread.
sam: saw a spike of TypeErrors in integration tests referencing optional peerDeps. local smoke looked fine. publishing command used: `npm publish --tag latest`.
anya: staging artifact had `peerDependencies` entry missing `@redwood/transport` in TS package.json. looks like packaging script dropped a merge change.
cheng: docs: do we need to add an urgent note? customers may see runtime import errors.
maria: hold on promotions. DO NOT publish any subsequent patch until we confirm rollback plan. @sam can you confirm if we can republish a patched 1.6.1 or if we need to yank 1.6.0?
sam: quick options: (1) yank 1.6.0 via npm deprecate and republish 1.6.1; (2) repoint dist-tag to 1.5.4; (3) unpublish 1.6.0 (not allowed for >72h). Recommend dist-tag flip + deprecate.
deploy-bot: alert: 47 downloads in last 5m with 12 failing CI jobs. package: @redwood/sdk-typescript 1.6.0. artifact-verify ok.
anya: we can patch the package.json and repack; build server can push 1.6.1 with corrected peerDeps in ~18m.
maria: do the flip to be safe. jordan (support) craft a short status line: "TypeScript SDK 1.6.0 has a packaging regression affecting peer dependencies. We recommend pinning to 1.5.x while we publish a fix." Keep it under 1 sentence.
cheng: drafted note. also adding pin snippet: `npm install @redwood/sdk-typescript@1.5.4` and pip pin guidance for python users.
sam: performing dist-tag flip: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-typescript@1.5.4 latest` then `npm deprecate @redwood/sdk-typescript@1.6.0 "Packaging regression: use 1.5.4 or wait for 1.6.1"`.
deploy-bot: dist-tag update: latest -> 1.5.4 by sam. deprecate issued for 1.6.0.
maria: good. open a short postmortem doc pointer in thread and add rollback commands to runbook. who will publish 1.6.1?
sam: i will publish 1.6.1 after CI build that includes patched package.json. ETA 20m. will publish under 'next' first, smoke test, then promote.
anya: confirm repacked tarball excludes stray README.tmp and includes peerDeps. i will verify.
support-bot: customer alerts created for customers who downloaded >=10 copies in last hour.
maria: once 1.6.1 is verified, i'll approve dist-tag flip. until then, support handle any escalations with the pin instructions.
cheng: adding the deprecation/sunset blurb for legacy sync in the release notes too (no change to plan).
sam: CI green, publishing 1.6.1 under 'next' now. smoke tests running.
deploy-bot: package-publish event: @redwood/sdk-typescript 1.6.1 published (tag: next).
anya: smoke tests OK. import + basic run + sample app passes.
maria: thanks. waiting 30m observe window. if stable, promote to latest and lift deprecation notice.
sam: ack.
deploy-bot: dist-tag-flip scheduled at 23:42 UTC (pending manual confirmation from maria).
